Prince Maidono"You're going to Fudaraku Castle...?"
Muramasa"Yes."
Kuronose"Reckless! Again and again we have sent spies into that castle. Out of ten, not even two get in successfully."

Chief"If we had somebody inside the shogunate to guide us, different matter. That arrangement is not ready yet."
Chief"Not possible now, Muramasa."
Muramasa"..."

en.html:
As I had expected, nobody agreed. Those not objecting were Ichijou Ayane, who was saying nothing, and the people who were not there. A very limited support base.

Kanae Ootori and her chamberlain had disappeared from the temple. Apparently they had flown abroad for some quiet maneuvering. Something at UN headquarters, they had explained; what exactly, I had not understood.

Kanae Ootori and her chamberlain had disappeared from the temple. Apparently they had flown abroad for some quiet maneuvering. Something at UN headquarters, they had explained; what exactly, I had not understood.

ja.html:
予想はしていたが、誰も賛同しなかった。
　反対していないのは黙りこくっている綾弥一条と、
そもそもこの場にいない人間だけだ。

　大鳥香奈枝とその侍従の姿は寺から消えている。
　何やらの裏工作をするため、今は<ruby>夷国<rt>いこく</rt></ruby>に飛んでいる
そうだ。国連本部でどうとかという説明だったけれど、
私には良くわからない。

Prince Maidono"I understand wanting to save Kageaki. I feel the same, you know..."
Prince Maidono"But blindly rushing ahead, that won't do. At a time like this especially, keep the head cool."

Muramasa"...That is what I feel."
Chief"..."

en.html:
Chachamaru Ashikaga had said Hikaru Minato had little life left. That much was no lie. Looking at her with a tsurugi's eyes, I could reach the same conclusion.

Then Kageaki, who now wanted to keep Hikaru alive, and Chachamaru, who wanted to use Silver Star for some purpose of her own—they had little time as well.

No leisurely plan, surely. Whatever they meant to do, they would probably bring it to a conclusion soon.

And once that conclusion came...
Surely then, nothing could be put right. Nothing.

ja.html:
湊斗光の寿命は残り僅かだと、足利茶々丸は言って
いた。
　あの言葉に嘘はない――劒冑の眼で診ても同じ結論
を出せた。

　なら……
　湊斗光を生かしたい今の景明と、銀星号を利用して
何かの望みを遂げたい茶々丸にとっても、時間は残り
少ないということになる。

　悠長な計画を立てているとは思えない。
　何をするつもりでいるにしろ、短時日のうちに決着
をつける気だろう。

　そして、その決着がついてしまったなら。
　きっと――もう何もかも、<ruby>どうにもならない<rt>・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。

en.html:
Chief"Muramasa, wait."
Muramasa"..."
Chief"Your Highness... shall we?"
Prince Maidono"Yes. Somehow, this has settled it for me."
Kuronose"Indeed."
Muramasa"...?"
Chief"Muramasa, if you are going, work with us. Better chance that way."
Muramasa"—Eh?"
Muramasa"No, but... that would..."
Chief"Do not misunderstand. We have our own reasons."
Prince Maidono"Truthfully... we cannot sit around waiting either. We've been pushed to the point where it has to be a gamble, win or lose."
Kuronose"Despite our interference, Kuniuji Ashikaga's appointment as Lord General is settled. Even the date and time of the ceremony are fixed."
Chief"That ceremony means Rokuhara's restoration. Which means the decisive war with the occupation forces begins. The very worst situation we meant to prevent is approaching."
Prince Maidono"Kanae is working on the UN side, but whether she'll manage in time, who knows? We have to do something here also."
Chief"Something that forces them to cancel or postpone the ceremony, if necessary. That is how matters stand, Muramasa."
Muramasa"..."

署長「村正、待て」
村正「……」
署長「宮殿下……宜しいですか？」
舞殿宮「せやな。 　なんか、これで踏ん切りがついたわ」
黒瀬「確かに」
村正「……？」
署長「村正、行くなら我々と協力しろ。 　その方が見込みがある」
村正「――えっ？」
村正「いえ、でも。それは」
署長「誤解するな。 　我々には我々の事情があるのだ」
舞殿宮「ほんとのとこ言うと……こっちものんびり 待ってるわけにはいかなくてなぁ。 　一か八かの勝負をやらなァあかんとこまで 追い込まれてるんよ」
黒瀬「妨害工作の甲斐なく、足利邦氏への大将領 宣下は確定してしまった。 　既に式典の日時まで決まっている」
署長「宣下式典の実施は六波羅体制の復活と同義 であり、それは進駐軍との決戦開始と同義だ。 　我々が避けたかった、最悪の事態が迫って いる」
舞殿宮「香奈枝さんが国連方面で今動いてくれてる けど、間に合うかわからん。 　こっちでも手を打たんとならんかったんよ」
署長「無理矢理にでも、式典を中止ないし延期に できるような手を。 　……そういうわけだ、村正」
村正「…………」

en.html:
Kuronose"I have a personal reason as well. My sister-in-law is captive in Fudaraku Castle."
Kuronose"Many times I have planned her rescue; none succeeded. This time I want her out."
Prince Maidono"Sakurako... yes..."
Chief"As for the precise plan—"
Ichijou"Arre, what's there to knead and knead? Work the plan however you like, reckless will still be reckless."
Ichijou"Sneak in as far as we can. Once we're spotted, go wild. Wreck the place so thoroughly they couldn't hold a ceremony even if they begged."
Ichijou"Bas. We win."
Prince Maidono"..."
Chief"..."
Chief"Agreed."
Prince Maidono"AGREED?!"
Chief"We have too little information to make a proper operational plan. In that case, sitting and thinking is only time wasted."
Kuronose"Exactly, exactly. I support Ichijou."
Prince Maidono"...You lot are practically a gym with political opinions."
Chief"Then, broadly: Ayane, Kuronose and Muramasa enter Fudaraku."
Chief"Inside, Ayane wrecks the castle. Kuronose rescues Princess Sakurako. Muramasa finds Kageaki. I will work on preparing an escape route."
Chief"Agreed?"
Ichijou"Yeah."
Kuronose"Indeed."
Muramasa"...Yes."
